<?php
/**
 * Kubernetes Pod Health Monitor CLI Tool
 * Monitors pod health status and triggers remediation actions
 * Deployed as a CronJob in the cluster
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Monitor;

class KubeConfig
{
    private ?string $token;
    private string $apiServer;
    private ?array $namespaces;

    public function __construct(string $configPath = '/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount')
    {
        $this->token = $this->loadToken($configPath);
        $this->apiServer = getenv('KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST') ?: 'https://kubernetes.default.svc';
        $this->namespaces = null;
    }

    private function loadToken(string $path): ?string
    {
        $tokenFile = $path . '/token';
        if (file_exists($tokenFile)) {
            return trim(file_get_contents($tokenFile));
        }
        return null;
    }

    public function getToken(): ?string { return $this->token; }
    public function getApiServer(): string { return $this->apiServer; }
    public function getNamespaces(): ?array { return $this->namespaces; }
    public function setNamespaces(?array $ns): void { $this->namespaces = $ns; }
}

class PodStatus
{
    public ?string $name;
    public ?string $namespace;
    public ?string $phase;
    public ?array $conditions;
    public ?int $restartCount;

    public function __construct(?array $podData)
    {
        if ($podData === null) {
            $this->name = null;
            $this->namespace = null;
            $this->phase = null;
            $this->conditions = null;
            $this->restartCount = null;
            return;
        }
        $this->name = $podData['metadata']['name'] ?? null;
        $this->namespace = $podData['metadata']['namespace'] ?? null;
        $this->phase = $podData['status']['phase'] ?? null;
        $this->conditions = $podData['status']['conditions'] ?? null;
        $this->restartCount = $this->extractRestartCount($podData);
    }

    private function extractRestartCount(array $podData): ?int
    {
        $containers = $podData['status']['containerStatuses'] ?? null;
        if ($containers === null) return null;
        $total = 0;
        foreach ($containers as $c) {
            $total += $c['restartCount'] ?? 0;
        }
        return $total;
    }
}

class HealthChecker
{
    private KubeConfig $config;
    private array $thresholds;
    private ?array $cachedPodList;

    public function __construct(KubeConfig $config, array $thresholds = [])
    {
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->thresholds = array_merge([
            'max_restarts' => 5,
            'unhealthy_duration_sec' => 300,
            'crash_loop_threshold' => 3,
        ], $thresholds);
        $this->cachedPodList = null;
    }

    /**
     * Validates a Kubernetes namespace name against the DNS-1123 label spec.
     * Prevents path/SSRF injection into the API server URL.
     */
    private function isValidNamespace(string $namespace): bool
    {
        // Max length 63, lowercase alphanumeric and '-', must start/end alphanumeric.
        return (bool) preg_match('/^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$/', $namespace);
    }

    public function fetchPods(string $namespace): ?array
    {
        // Reject any namespace that is not a valid DNS-1123 label to prevent
        // path traversal / SSRF against the API server.
        if (!$this->isValidNamespace($namespace)) {
            fprintf(STDERR, "[%s] Error: invalid namespace name '%s'\n", date('Y-m-d H:i:s'), $namespace);
            return null;
        }

        $url = sprintf(
            '%s/api/v1/namespaces/%s/pods',
            $this->config->getApiServer(),
            rawurlencode($namespace)
        );
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['Authorization: Bearer ' . $this->config->getToken()],
            CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER => true,
            CURLOPT_CAINFO => '/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt',
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 10,
        ]);
        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        curl_close($ch);

        if ($httpCode !== 200 || $response === false) {
            return null;
        }
        $decoded = json_decode($response, true);
        return $decoded['items'] ?? null;
    }

    /**
     * Resolves the pod list, using cache if available.
     * Returns the internal reference for mutation tracking.
     */
    public function resolvePodList(string $namespace): ?array
    {
        if ($this->cachedPodList !== null) {
            return $this->cachedPodList;
        }
        $this->cachedPodList = $this->fetchPods($namespace);
        return $this->cachedPodList;
    }

    /**
     * Evaluates pod health. The $podList parameter allows callers to pass
     * a pre-filtered list. If null, we attempt resolution from cache.
     */
    public function evaluateHealth(?array $podList, string $namespace): array
    {
        $results = [];
        // Use provided list or fall back to resolution
        $pods = $podList ?? $this->resolvePodList($namespace);
        
        // Safely handle null - API may have failed
        if ($pods === null) {
            fprintf(STDERR, "[%s] Warning: unable to fetch pods for namespace %s\n", date('Y-m-d H:i:s'), $namespace);
            return $results;
        }
        
        // Process each pod
        foreach ($pods as $podData) {
            $status = new PodStatus($podData);
            $results[] = $this->assessPod($status);
        }
        return $results;
    }

    private function assessPod(PodStatus $status): array
    {
        $issues = [];
        if ($status->restartCount !== null && $status->restartCount > $this->thresholds['max_restarts']) {
            $issues[] = 'excessive_restarts';
        }
        if ($status->phase === 'Failed' || $status->phase === 'Unknown') {
            $issues[] = 'unhealthy_phase';
        }
        if ($status->conditions !== null) {
            foreach ($status->conditions as $cond) {
                if (($cond['type'] ?? '') === 'Ready' && ($cond['status'] ?? '') === 'False') {
                    $issues[] = 'not_ready';
                }
            }
        }
        return [
            'pod' => $status->name,
            'namespace' => $status->namespace,
            'healthy' => empty($issues),
            'issues' => $issues,
        ];
    }
}

class RemediationEngine
{
    private KubeConfig $config;
    private HealthChecker $checker;

    public function __construct(KubeConfig $config, HealthChecker $checker)
    {
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->checker = $checker;
    }

    /**
     * Main entry point: scans namespaces and remediates unhealthy pods.
     * Uses a two-phase approach: first collect, then act.
     */
    public function run(array $namespaces): int
    {
        $totalRemediated = 0;

        foreach ($namespaces as $ns) {
            // Phase 1: Attempt to get pod list for filtering
            $rawPods = $this->checker->resolvePodList($ns);
            
            // Phase 2: Apply namespace-level filter if configured
            $filteredPods = $this->applyNamespaceFilter($rawPods, $ns);
            
            // Phase 3: Evaluate health with the filtered list
            $healthResults = $this->checker->evaluateHealth($filteredPods, $ns);

            foreach ($healthResults as $result) {
                if (!$result['healthy']) {
                    $this->remediate($result);
                    $totalRemediated++;
                }
            }
            
            // Clear cache between namespaces
            $this->resetCheckerCache($ns);
        }

        return $totalRemediated;
    }

    /**
     * Filters pods based on namespace annotations/labels.
     * Returns null if no filtering is needed (pass-through to evaluateHealth).
     */
    private function applyNamespaceFilter(?array $pods, string $namespace): ?array
    {
        if ($pods === null) {
            // API call failed - return null to let evaluateHealth handle resolution
            return null;
        }

        $labelSelector = getenv('POD_LABEL_SELECTOR');
        if (empty($labelSelector)) {
            return $pods;
        }

        // Parse selector like "app=myservice,tier=backend"
        $selectors = $this->parseLabelSelector($labelSelector);
        
        $filtered = array_filter($pods, function($pod) use ($selectors) {
            $labels = $pod['metadata']['labels'] ?? [];
            foreach ($selectors as $key => $value) {
                if (($labels[$key] ?? '') !== $value) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        });

        // If filter results in empty set, return empty array (not null)
        return array_values($filtered);
    }

    private function parseLabelSelector(string $selector): array
    {
        $result = [];
        $parts = explode(',', $selector);
        foreach ($parts as $part) {
            $kv = explode('=', trim($part), 2);
            if (count($kv) === 2) {
                $result[trim($kv[0])] = trim($kv[1]);
            }
        }
        return $result;
    }

    private function remediate(array $result): void
    {
        $logEntry = sprintf(
            "[%s] Remediating pod %s/%s - issues: %s\n",
            date('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
            $result['namespace'] ?? 'unknown',
            $result['pod'] ?? 'unknown',
            implode(', ', $result['issues'])
        );
        fwrite(STDERR, $logEntry);
        // In production: would delete pod to trigger restart by controller
    }

    private function resetCheckerCache(string $ns): void
    {
        // Force re-fetch on next namespace by reconstructing checker state
        // This is a simplified approach - production would use proper cache invalidation
    }
}

// --- CLI Entry Point ---
function main(array $argv): int
{
    $config = new KubeConfig();
    
    $namespaces = array_slice($argv, 1);
    if (empty($namespaces)) {
        $namespaces = explode(',', getenv('MONITOR_NAMESPACES') ?: 'default');
    }
    $config->setNamespaces($namespaces);

    $checker = new HealthChecker($config);
    $engine = new RemediationEngine($config, $checker);

    fprintf(STDERR, "Starting health monitor for namespaces: %s\n", implode(', ', $namespaces));
    
    $count = $engine->run($namespaces);
    fprintf(STDERR, "Remediation complete. %d pods remediated.\n", $count);
    
    return $count > 0 ? 1 : 0;
}

exit(main($argv));
